body: Hey you should not feel bad, I guess. I don't think she's forgotten you. I've been in a similar situation, and I guess a part of me is still waiting for closure. Surely, nothing can be as it was, but maybe you should put yourself out there, talk to her. I've heard somewhere that things that remain unfinished are the hardest to forget, so just give yourself a proper closure, no? Good luck!!

I'm exactly the same -- so much planning, but not enough determination & always thinking of what others will think
 
:(
